checks.explanation: AI capital expenditure remained enormous through 2026 with early signs of productivity gains in specific sectors, but a broad economy-wide productivity boom handoff had not been clearly confirmed by mid-2026.
The Fed delivered three 25bp cuts in 2025 (September, October, December), exceeding the predicted 1-2 cuts within the year.

US tariff revenue rose sharply after the 2025 tariff hikes, running at an annualized pace in the low hundreds of billions, but whether a full 300 billion dollars was collected within the specific 12-month window is not clearly confirmed.
Natural gas remained the largest source of new US electricity generation capacity additions through 2025-2026, driven heavily by AI data center demand.

No three Generation IV nuclear reactors had gone critical at Idaho National Laboratory by summer 2026; advanced reactor demonstration projects there remained in earlier construction and licensing stages.

Small modular reactors continued to attract major investment and pilot projects through 2025-2026, but full free-market viability without subsidy is a roughly 10-year-out claim that cannot yet be evaluated.
No specific, verifiable record of the Department of Energy announcing exactly four AI-factory data center sites the day after this taping was found.
The Trump administration pursued policies to slow planned power-plant retirements and expand generation capacity, but hitting the specific targets remains too early to confirm at scale.

Demand and wages for skilled trades workers tied to data center and energy buildout grew notably through 2025-2026, with some specialized roles reaching high five- and six-figure pay, but a broad 'explosion' of jobs paying up to 150K was not comprehensively confirmed.
The Trump administration did implement an August 1, 2025 deadline mechanism under which countries without finalized trade deals faced tariff rates snapping up from the baseline level.
A deal restructuring TikTok's US operations under majority American ownership (the Oracle-led consortium) was finalized in January 2026, confirming the prediction.
